title: Deadline for Quizzes & Assignments Marks
detail:
Attention Teachers and Students!

This is to inform everyone that tomorrow, April 13, 2026, is the final deadline for uploading marks for:

Quiz # 01 & 02

Assignment # 01 & 02

For Teachers: Requesting all faculty members to kindly finalize and upload the marks on the portal before the day ends to avoid any technical delays.

For Students: Those who still have pending submissions or missed their assessments are strictly advised to contact their respective teachers and submit their work before the portal closes.

Note: No marks will be entertained after the deadline.

title: Mid-Term Examinations – Spring 2026
detail: Mid-Term examinations are starting from April 13, 2026. Students are advised to collect their admit cards and verify their datesheets from the department notice board. Ensure 75% attendance and bring your University ID card. Good luck!
